about: True parameters of the mta extension dataset in data/synthetic/, written by scripts/make_synthetic.py from src/mktstats/synth/. Do not edit by hand.
csv_encoding: In mta_journeys.csv each touch of `path` is one letter (path_codes: P is paid search), in time order with no separator, so the file stays small; decode a path with ' > '.join(path_codes[k] for k in path). The generator's journeys table has decoded paths.

dgp.description: One month, one market of n_users users. Intent z ~ Normal(0, 1). Channel c reaches a user with probability expit(a_c + g_c z), independently across channels given z (g_c > 0: the channel targets users who already intend to buy; random_exposure replaces this with the constant E_z[expit(a_c + g_c z)]). A reached user gets 1 + Poisson(m_c) touches from c at times drawn from Beta(e_c, f_c) on [0, 1]; the path lists touches in time order. The user converts at the end of the month when U < expit(theta0 + delta z + sum_c theta_c R_c), with U ~ Uniform(0, 1) and R_c = 1 if c reached the user: only which channels reached the user matters, not the order or number of touches. Retargeting has theta = 0 by construction. Users with no touch have no tracked journey, but their conversions count in the truth.

definition: incremental_conversions[c] = sum over all n_users users of [Y_i - Y_i^(-c)], where Y_i^(-c) is the user's outcome had channel c not reached them, with intent, the other channels and the user's uniform draw U_i unchanged (common random numbers). incremental_conversions_expected[c] is the same sum of conversion probabilities.

economics.note: Monthly spend is an assumption of the synthetic world. Margin per conversion = one order at the retailer's population mean spend (truth.json retailer.population_mean_spend) x the workshop's gross margin (truth.json channel_value.margin); repeat purchases are ignored. Email is list-limited and cannot scale.
